versions.changelog:
Initial release of gstable-ai-payment.

- Enables AI agents to discover, negotiate, and execute cryptocurrency payments for users.
- Supports retrieving payment link details, checking balances, creating sessions (EIP-712 signatures), and executing on-chain payments.
- Includes multi-chain support (Polygon, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base) and major stablecoins.
- Provides comprehensive CLI commands for initiating, preparing, and completing payments, with a one-command payment option.
- Requires only a wallet private key for setup; optional configuration for API URL and payer email.
